title: Customer Service Advisors
description:
CCP are delighted to partner with a growing successful company who specialise in Debt Recovery and are a leader within their market. We're currently supporting them to recruit new Customer Service Advisors for their expanding specialist department at their Head Office in Truro. These roles will be office-based.

As a Customer Service Advisors, you will be responsible for providing exceptional service by building strong relationships with customers, understanding their needs, and maintaining clear communication. You'll work closely with internal teams to ensure queries are resolved efficiently, customers receive accurate information, and every interaction reflects the company's commitment to excellence.

Salary: £30,030
Bonus: Uncapped commission
Hours: 37.5 Hours Per Week Monday to Friday, 9am to 5.30pm & required to work 1 in 4 Saturdays 9am to 1pm
Start Date: ASAP
Benefits: Company Pension, performance bonus, yearly bonus, paid company events & incentives.
What You'll Need:
+ Excellent professional communication skills with the ability to maintain customer relationships.
+ Strong personable skills for positive and successful outcomes.
+ Have attention to detail with updating customer records with an accurate details.
+ Confident and Resilient with handling empathic conversations.

If you're looking for a role where you can help and guide your customers, your driven and can handle a busy working environment in a company with exciting growth plans, please apply today!

This opportunity is being recruited for by CCP and is being managed by Dan Green. If this role is of interest and you feel you have the relevant experience, please apply online and we will aim to respond to your application within 72 hours.

title: Finance Accounts Assistant
description:
Finance Accounts Assistant Finance Assistant Accounts Administrator

Truro £26,000-£28,000 depending on skills and experience 35 hours per week 5 days Permanent

Introduction

We are looking for an Accounts Assistant to work from our Truro office, as part of our Finance Team and in collaboration with other departments.

Part-time hours, with a minimum of 25 hours per week over a 5-day week, may be considered.

What We Offer
- 35-hour week, supporting a great work-life balance.
- Private medical insurance and income protection cover.
- 24 days' holiday, increasing to 28 days per year with length of service, plus bank holidays.
- The option to 'buy' an extra 5 days per year after a qualifying period.
- Comprehensive induction programme.
- Excellent learning and development opportunities, including professional memberships and relevant qualifications.
- Up to 25% discount on products and access to exclusive Member discounts on other everyday essentials.
- Company events to support social wellbeing.

Key Duties
- Manage payment queries from internal teams and directly from Members.
- Manage and handle payments, direct debit instructions and refunds of insurance premiums.
- Make calls to Members to discuss late or missing payments.
- Process invoices and set up purchasing and claims payments.
- Handle and prepare for banking all monies received in accordance with agreed company procedures.
- Complete bank reconciliations.

Requirements
- Previous experience working in Accounts.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Excellent customer service, administrative and organisational skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel.
- Flexible and solution-driven.
- GCSE Maths at grade 6 or above.

Interested?

If you are interested in the Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Accounts Administrator role and have the relevant skills and experience, apply now.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Temporary Payroll Assistant - £14.00 - £15.00 per hour - Full or Part Time - Initial 3 Month Contract with Potential for Extension

An established business is seeking a Payroll Assistant to join its payroll team on a temporary basis. This role has been created to provide additional support during a particularly busy period and will focus on payroll administration, data entry, reconciliations, and supporting the accurate processing of monthly payrolls.

Working as part of an experienced payroll team, you will play a key role in ensuring payroll information is processed accurately and on time across multiple payrolls, while assisting with HMRC reporting and payroll administration duties.

Key Responsibilities

Processing and maintaining payroll records

Accurate input and validation of payroll data

Supporting the monthly processing of two payrolls covering approximately 700 employees across multiple entities

Processing new starters and leavers

Assisting with payroll reconciliations and balancing activities

Supporting HMRC submissions, RTI reporting and general payroll compliance

Assisting with statutory payments including SSP and other payroll-related calculations

Supporting pension administration and submissions

Working with time and attendance data to ensure payroll accuracy

Investigating and resolving payroll discrepancies

Responding to payroll-related queries from employees and managers

Providing general administrative support to the wider payroll function

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a Payroll Assistant, Payroll Administrator, or similar payroll support role, together with a good understanding of payroll processes and administration. You will have excellent attention to detail, strong data entry skills, and be comfortable working with large volumes of information while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

You should be organised, dependable, and capable of managing priorities within a deadline-driven environment. Knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC requirements would be advantageous, as would experience using payroll software such as MorePay or time and attendance systems such as Kronos, although neither is essential.

Please apply ASAP to Elle Benjamin quoting reference EB11279.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS POST MAY CLOSE EARLY IN THE EVENT THERE ARE A NUMBER OF APPLICATIONS.It may not be possible to respond to all interested applicants due to the volume of interest shown on previous job adverts and we apologise for this. An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our friendly and hardworking Reception Team for a part-time/full time colleague. Receptionists serve as the first point of contact for patients and visitors, providing exceptional customer service in a busy fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for undertaking a wide range of duties including (but not limited to): Responding to patient queries in a timely, helpful and professional manner Managing appointments effectively and efficiently Handling enquiries either over the phone or in person at the front desk Maintaining accurate patient records Utilising information systems to support efficient workflow processes Actioning information, messages and enquiries for the clinical teams Upholding confidentiality at all times Our ideal candidate will have: A positive forward-thinking attitude Flexible approach Excellent communication skills Reception or customer service experience Basic PC skills such as Word, Excel The hours are worked between Monday to Friday and the successful candidate will be expected to work across Helston and Porthleven practices. The following are the core responsibilities of the receptionist. There may be on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks; this will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: a. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system b. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments c. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately d. Signpost patients to the correct service e. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies f. Photocopy documentation as required g. Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required h. Input data into the patients healthcare records as necessary i. Direct requests for information i.e. SAR, insurance / solicitors letters and DVLA forms to the administrative team j. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner k. Carry out system searches as requested l. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times m. Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards n. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested
